scene: The warm soup tingles delightfully, revealing transit gates along the bridge edge.
picture: A flat side view along the edge of Gear Bridge. On the far left, a glowing funicular car rests at a gate. Left of centre, the player stands holding an empty soup bowl. Hanging at centre is a yellow-striped suspended gondola. On the far right, a shiny red mail train sits with open doors.
shown: a glass-domed funicular car parked on tilted rails at the far left
a striped window-cleaner gondola swinging from overhead cables at centre
a scarlet pneumatic mail train sitting at a dock on the far right
